decision: Actual funded profitability alone is still too permissive as a compounder state. It reduces union and common-five wealth and slightly reduces leader-removal wealth. Do not search profit margins, confirmation days or neighboring basis thresholds.
next_root_cause: The ownership engine needs an explicit proven-compounder state that requires both actual funded price improvement and causal alpha improvement from admission, rather than a one-dimensional score-sign or cost-basis predicate. This should be implemented as one unified offensive ownership core rather than another exit wrapper.
evidence_readback: Dedicated hosted workflow completed focused tests, source-bound measurement, artifact upload, research/evidence append and remote SHA read-back successfully.
